title: USA: Warsh Does Not Address October FOMC Meeting but Says “World Has Broadly Conformed to Our Expectations” Since Last Meeting

classification.rationale: The note uses Warsh's and other FOMC participants' comments to conclude the Fed will pause at the October meeting, with a final hike expected in December.
classification.runner_up_reason: The December hike call is a rate-path view, but the main point is the October pause signal.
